title: 第989章 扩散第988章 心神剧颤
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
“别误会。”
楚歌淡淡地斜睨他一眼，语气平淡无波，听不出半分起伏。
“这种粗劣不堪的破铜烂铁，还没有资格存入我的宝库。”
“前些日子筱竹烹制深海魔章铁板烧，剩下一堆章鱼骨刺无处安置，我见你那藏宝匣看着还算坚固，便随手将残渣丢了进去。至于这柄破剑..........”
楚歌侧过头，望向身侧的萧云缨。
“云缨，前日你拿它做什么了？”
萧云缨微微撇起嘴唇，看向地上扭曲的斩天剑胚，脸上满是难以掩饰的嫌弃，从容开口。
“公子，那日您想要品尝烤肉，缺少劈柴兵刃，我便随手拎起这根黑铁棍去劈砍火灵木。”
“谁能想到这东西如此不堪一击，仅仅劈了两下，剑刃便直接卷翘变形，实在太过耽误事。”
“轰——！！！”
林天识海之内，仿佛上万道神雷同时轰然炸开，震荡得神魂摇摇欲坠。
那是他寄托一切的本命至宝，是他希冀重返巅峰最大的依仗，更是前世身为无上剑帝引以为傲的无上荣耀！
可如今真相赤裸裸摆在眼前，这件珍贵无比的斩天剑胚。
竟被众人随手拿去劈柴，甚至用来盛放厨余残渣！
“啊啊啊啊啊——！！！”
极致的屈辱、焚尽一切的怒火与无边无际的绝望交织在一起，汹涌逆血直冲天灵！
他那历经无数厮杀磨砺、早已坚不可摧，却本就布满细微裂痕的无敌剑心。
此刻清晰传出一道“咔嚓”令人心神发凉的脆响，轰然碎裂，化作漫天齑粉！
可楚歌层层诛心的举动，远远没有到此为止。
他缓缓转过视线，落在一旁心神同样濒临彻底崩溃的叶辰身上。

“至于你.........”
楚歌指尖轻轻一打响指，清脆响声回荡高台。
一旁的陈筱竹立刻步履轻盈乖巧上前，双手捧着一只玲珑玉碗。
碗中静静盛放着半碗香气浓郁的汤汁，一眼便能看出是饮用剩余的残汤。
“这碗汤，便是用前几日你赌上半条性命，拼死闯入毒谷，费尽心力挖掘得来的那株‘万年星元果’熬煮而成。”
楚歌静静注视着叶辰因暴怒不断扭曲抽搐的面孔，语调平淡，夹杂着几分戏谑的怜悯。
“可惜，你采药之时手段太过粗糙鲁莽，果子沾染了浓重的血腥浊气。”
“我身边小白狐仅仅尝了两口，便满心嫌恶地吐了出来。”
“不过，念在这一个多月以来，你勤勤恳恳奔波各处，为本公子的后花园挖矿寻药，劳苦一场。这剩下的半碗汤汁，便赏赐给你。”
“也算不辜负你对虚无缥缈的‘仙帝传承’，那一片痴心虔诚。”
话音落下，楚歌随意抬手一挥。
“啪！”
玉碗重重砸落在叶辰身前的白玉石台之上，当场碎裂开来。
混着星元果果肉残渣的汤汁四下飞溅，尽数泼洒，不少液体直接溅在叶辰的脸颊、发丝之上，黏腻温热。
“打黑工........”
“仙帝传承是假的........耗费性命采摘的神药，只是拿来给狐狸熬汤的........”
content_en:
"Don't get me wrong."
Chu Ge glanced at him indifferently, his tone was calm, and there was no fluctuation at all.
"This kind of shoddy scrap metal is not qualified to be stored in my treasure house."
"A few days ago, Xiaozhu cooked the Deep Sea Demon Chapter Teppanyaki, and there was a pile of octopus bone spurs left with nowhere to put it. I saw that your treasure box looked quite strong, so I threw the residue in. As for this broken sword..."
Chu Ge turned his head and looked at Xiao Yunying beside him.
"Yunying, what did you do with it the day before yesterday?"
Xiao Yunying curled up her lips slightly and looked at the twisted embryo of the Heaven-Destroying Sword on the ground. Her face was full of disgust that could not be concealed, and she spoke calmly.
"Sir, you wanted to taste barbecue that day, but you lacked a wood-chopping weapon, so I just picked up this black iron rod and chopped down the fire wood."
"Who would have thought that this thing is so vulnerable. After just two blows, the sword blade curled up and deformed. It really delayed things."
"Boom——!!!"
Within Lin Tian's sea of consciousness, it was as if tens of thousands of divine thunders exploded at the same time, shaking his soul to the point of collapse.
It was the most precious treasure on which he had placed everything, and was his greatest support in hoping to return to the top. It was also the supreme honor that he was proud of as the Supreme Sword Emperor in his previous life!
But now the truth is naked before our eyes, this extremely precious Heaven-Destroying Sword embryo.
It was used by everyone to chop firewood and even used to hold kitchen scraps!
“Ahhhhhhh——!!!”
Extreme humiliation, all-consuming anger and boundless despair are intertwined, and the surging blood rushes straight to the heavenly spirit!
His invincible sword heart has been tempered by countless battles and has long been indestructible, but it is already full of tiny cracks.
At this moment, there was a clear and chilling "click" sound, and it shattered into pieces and turned into powder all over the sky!
But Chu Ge's heart-breaking actions did not end there.
He slowly turned his gaze and landed on Ye Chen, who was also on the verge of complete collapse.
"As for you..."
Chu Ge lightly snapped his fingers, and a crisp sound echoed on the high platform.
Chen Xiaozhu on the side immediately stepped forward with light and obedient steps, holding an exquisite jade bowl in both hands.
The bowl is filled with half a bowl of fragrant soup, and you can tell at a glance that it is the leftover soup.
"This bowl of soup is made from the 'Ten Thousand Years Star Fruit' that you risked half your life to break into the Poison Valley a few days ago and dug out with all your efforts."
Chu Ge quietly watched Ye Chen's face that was constantly twisting and twitching due to rage, his tone was calm, mixed with a bit of joking pity.
"Unfortunately, your method of collecting the medicine was too rough and reckless, and the fruit was contaminated with a strong bloody odor."
"The little white fox next to me only tasted it twice before spitting it out with disgust."
"However, remembering that for more than a month, you have been working diligently everywhere, digging for mines and medicine in my master's back garden, and you have worked hard. I will give you the remaining half bowl of soup as a reward."
"It can be considered as living up to your infatuated devotion to the illusory 'Immortal Emperor's inheritance'."
After the words fell, Chu Ge raised his hand and waved casually.
"Crack!"
The jade bowl hit the white jade stone platform in front of Ye Chen hard and broke into pieces on the spot.
The soup mixed with the pulp residue of Xingyuan Fruit splashed everywhere, and a lot of liquid splashed directly on Ye Chen's cheeks and hair, making it sticky and warm.
"Crack down on illegal work..."
"The inheritance of the Immortal Emperor is fake... The magic medicine that was spent on harvesting is just used to make soup for the fox..."
